description: Windows security log collected into the SecurityEvent table (Azure Monitor Agent / Defender for Servers).

queries.name: Failed logons for an account (4625)
queries.description: Failed logon attempts for a user name, with source IP and logon type.
kql: | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, LogonType, IpAddress, WorkstationName, Status, SubStatus

queries.name: Successful logons for an account (4624)
queries.description: Where and how an account logged on (LogonType 2 console, 3 network, 10 RDP ...).
kql: | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, LogonType, IpAddress, WorkstationName

queries.name: Failed logons by source IP
queries.description: Brute-force indicators: IPs failing against many accounts or machines.
kql: | where EventID == 4625 and isnotempty(IpAddress) and IpAddress != '-'
| summarize Failures = count(), Accounts = dcount(TargetUserName), Computers = dcount(Computer), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by IpAddress

queries.name: Account lockouts (4740)
queries.description: Accounts locked out, and the machine that caused it.
kql: | project TimeGenerated, Computer, TargetUserName, TargetDomainName, Activity

queries.name: Security group membership changes (4728/4732/4756)
queries.description: Members added to global, local or universal security groups.
kql: | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Activity, MemberName, TargetUserName, SubjectAccount

queries.name: Account create / enable / disable / delete / reset
queries.description: 4720 created, 4722 enabled, 4723/4724 password change/reset, 4725 disabled, 4726 deleted.
kql: | project TimeGenerated, Computer, EventID, Activity, TargetAccount, SubjectAccount

queries.name: Security log cleared (1102)
queries.description: Someone cleared the security audit log.
